text: あいて　ポケモンへの　こうか　◎ほのお　こおり　ひこう　むし　△かくとう　じめん　はがね

structure.jp: あいて　ポケモンへの　こうか
◎ほのお　こおり　ひこう　むし
structure.en: super effective: Fire, Ice, Flying, Bug

structure.jp: △かくとう　じめん　はがね
structure.en: not very effective: Fighting, Ground, Steel

patterns.name: 〜への
patterns.explanation: へ means 'toward', and の ties that to the next thing, so it is an effect aimed at something. あいて　ポケモンへの　こうか = 'the effect on the opposing Pokémon'.
